claim_text: Global CO2 concentrations in 2023 exceeded 420 ppm.

evidence_spans.span_text: CO2 concentrations measured in 2023 were above 420 ppm at Mauna Loa.

claim_text: Renewable energy provided over 25% of global electricity in 2020.

evidence_spans.span_text: Renewables exceeded 25% of global electricity generation in 2020.

claim_text: Sea level rise accelerated after 1993 according to satellite data.

evidence_spans.span_text: Satellite altimetry shows an acceleration in sea level rise since 1993.

claim_text: Wind and solar together produce more than 10% of global electricity.

evidence_spans.span_text: Combined solar and wind output accounts for over 10% of world electricity.

claim_text: Battery costs have declined dramatically since 2010.

evidence_spans.span_text: Lithium-ion battery prices dropped sharply between 2010 and 2020.

claim_text: The Paris Agreement was adopted in 2015.

evidence_spans.span_text: The Paris Agreement was agreed upon at COP21 in 2015.

claim_text: Ice loss in Greenland contributes to global sea level rise.

evidence_spans.span_text: Mass loss from the Greenland ice sheet raises global mean sea levels.

claim_text: EV sales have grown rapidly since 2018.

evidence_spans.span_text: Electric vehicle sales increased significantly each year after 2018.

claim_text: Ocean acidification is caused by absorption of atmospheric CO2.

evidence_spans.span_text: The oceans absorb CO2 from the atmosphere, causing pH to decrease.

claim_text: Agricultural emissions include methane from livestock and nitrous oxide from soils.

evidence_spans.span_text: Livestock produce methane and fertilised soils release N2O, both greenhouse gases.

claim_text: Global mean temperature is higher today than in the pre-industrial era.

evidence_spans.span_text: The current global average temperature exceeds the 1850–1900 baseline.

claim_text: The ozone layer is recovering following the Montreal Protocol.

evidence_spans.span_text: Ozone layer recovery is underway as ozone-depleting substances decline.

claim_text: Solar PV costs fell faster than projected by IEA models from 2010 to 2020.

evidence_spans.span_text: Solar PV cost reductions exceeded IEA projections over 2010–2020.

claim_text: Deforestation in tropical regions releases stored carbon into the atmosphere.

evidence_spans.span_text: Tropical deforestation releases large amounts of carbon previously stored in trees.

claim_text: China has the largest installed wind capacity in the world.

evidence_spans.span_text: China leads the world in total installed wind power capacity.

claim_text: Permafrost contains organic carbon frozen for millennia.

evidence_spans.span_text: Permafrost soils hold large amounts of ancient organic carbon.

claim_text: Coral bleaching is caused by elevated sea temperatures.

evidence_spans.span_text: Thermal stress from warm ocean temperatures triggers coral bleaching.

claim_text: Nuclear power emits very little CO2 per unit of electricity generated.

evidence_spans.span_text: Nuclear energy has among the lowest lifecycle GHG emissions per kWh.

claim_text: Building insulation reduces heating energy demand.

evidence_spans.span_text: Better insulation lowers the amount of energy needed to heat buildings.

claim_text: Rising temperatures increase the risk of wildfires globally.

evidence_spans.span_text: Higher temperatures and drought increase wildfire probability in many regions.
